title: Pull Requests and Code Review
description: Practice pull requests and code review through a concrete team scenario.

blocks.content: You have finished a feature and want feedback before it reaches the main branch. A pull request gives the team a review point. What is the smallest Git action that keeps the work safe?

A pull request is a request to compare and merge a branch. It gives reviewers a focused place to discuss changes before they reach the shared branch.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["Working files"] -->|"choose an action"| B["Git history"] -->|"share or recover"| C["Team project"]
```

blocks.question: What is the purpose of a pull request?
options: Review a proposed branch change before merge
blocks.explanation: A pull request creates a shared review point for a focused change.

blocks.prompt: Model the Git idea in a tiny simulator. Export a function named `reviewFile` that takes `(working, staged, file)` and returns a new staged list containing `file` once. Do not change either input list.

tests.description: works when no working files are listed yet
keeps an already staged file while adding another
